purpose: Attach the municipal postal-address point to an existing sports business without changing its address, services, booking or price.

business.name: Плувен клуб Люлин–София
business.address: София, ж.к. Люлин 3, ул. 309 № 8, басейн на 33 ОУ Санкт Петербург
business.booking: Keep enquiry and advance phone booking via +359885721337. This is not a GoRez booking, a published slot or an availability guarantee.
business.inventory: Keep the existing single children's one-to-one swimming lesson and its 25 EUR tariff for one participant. No new service, price validity window, timetable or opening hours are introduced.

sources.evidence: The club identifies the 33rd School Saint Petersburg in Lyulin 3 as its public venue and publishes the retained enquiry phone. Its map embed was not used.
The club's own pool page confirms the swimming pool is at the 33rd School, rather than an office or a generic area served.
The official Lyulin district schools register identifies the host school by name and explicitly gives Lyulin 3, 309 Street No. 8.
The city schools directory independently lists the same named school and complete civic address.
The booking instructions say individual lessons are arranged on enquiry and publish the existing phone for booking.
The owner's tariff lists 25 EUR per one-to-one lesson for one person, distinct from two- and three-person fees. This location attachment does not renew the pricing review.

coordinateReview.method: Manually matched the exact numbered street and house fields against one original municipal CSV row after the operator and two municipal directories matched the same named host. The generic free-text parser does not recognize this numeric street and number-sign spelling; no parser or public address was edited.
coordinateReview.semantics: Verified address point for the 33rd School postal address, not a verified pool entrance or specific doorway.

identities.guard: Attach the point only to the exact reviewed unlocated premises, phone and booking/contact URLs.
